paragraphs.text: You can book a practical driving test once you have passed the theory test. The theory test certificate is valid for two years, so you must pass the practical test within that time.
Tests can be booked online up to 24 weeks in advance. You will need your driving licence number and your theory test certificate number to complete the booking.
The standard fee for a weekday test is £62. Tests on evenings, weekends and public holidays cost £75.
On the day of the test, arrive at the test centre at least 10 minutes early and bring your licence. If you use your own car, it must have an extra mirror for the examiner.

If you need to change or cancel your test, give at least three working days’ notice, or you will lose the fee. Results are given at the end of the test, and successful candidates receive their certificate on the same day.
